# Hydra Sync 1.7.0

Per-game control over what Hydra Sync updates, so games can sync playtime, achievements, or both.

## What's new

### Per-game sync modes

Right-click any game (or multi-select several) and pick from the `Hydra Sync` section:

| Menu item | What gets synced for the selected game(s) |
|---|---|
| `Sync both playtime and achievements` | Playtime **and** achievements — the default, and selecting it clears a previous override |
| `Sync playtime only` | Only playtime is updated |
| `Sync achievements only` | Only achievements are updated |

- The active mode for the selection is labelled **`(current)`** in the menu.
- Modes are stored per game in `sync_state.json` and survive restarts.
- The sync notification now reports how many games were skipped because of an override
  (e.g. *"per-game sync mode: achievements skipped on 3 game(s)"*).
- **Diagnose achievement sync…** (game context menu) includes the game's current mode.
- Global **Sync playtime** / **Sync achievements** switches are still master switches:
  a per-game mode can only narrow what happens, never re-enable something switched off.

## Upgrade notes

- If you relied on automatic syncing, note that **auto-sync is opt-in since 1.6.0** — enable
  `Auto-sync` in the extension settings if you want the scheduled passes back.
- No database changes or re-sync required; existing per-game data keeps syncing both ways
  until you set a mode for it.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.7.0.pext` from the assets below.
2. Double-click it in Playnite and confirm the update (Playnite offers to restart), or
   extract it to `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`.
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live under **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
Full changelog: https://github.com/cometmcisaac/hydra-playnite-sync/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0
